mapper.select: select tenant_id from batch.tenant where tenant_id > #{after} order by tenant_id limit #{limit}
mapper.update: with due as ( select id from batch.console_push_job_delivery where tenant_id=#{tenantId} and record_type='DEVICE' and ((delivery_status='IN_FLIGHT' and delivery_claim_until <= #{now}) or (delivery_status='PENDING' and attempt >= #{maxAttempts})) order by coalesce(delivery_claim_until,next_retry_at),id limit #{limit} ) update batch.console_push_job_delivery d set error_message=case when d.delivery_status='IN_FLIGHT' then 'UNKNOWN: in-flight claim expired; manual reconciliation required' else 'BUDGET: delivery attempts exhausted; manual reconciliation required' end, delivery_status='EXHAUSTED',next_retry_at=null, delivery_claim_token=null,delivery_claim_until=null where d.tenant_id=#{tenantId} and d.id in (select id from due) and ((d.delivery_status='IN_FLIGHT' and d.delivery_claim_until <= #{now}) or (d.delivery_status='PENDING' and d.attempt >= #{maxAttempts}))

update batch.console_push_job_delivery set delivery_status=#{status},next_retry_at=#{nextRetry,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, http_status=#{httpStatus,jdbcType=INTEGER},error_message=#{error,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, attempt=case when #{refundAttempt} then greatest(attempt-1,0) else attempt end, delivery_claim_token=null,delivery_claim_until=null where tenant_id=#{row.tenantId} and id=#{row.id} and terminal_event_key=#{row.terminalEventKey} and record_type='DEVICE' and delivery_status='IN_FLIGHT' and delivery_claim_token=#{token}::uuid
mapper.insert: insert into batch.console_push_job_delivery (tenant_id,terminal_event_key,job_instance_id,operator_id,record_type,decision,event_type,payload_json) values (#{tenantId},#{eventKey},#{jobId},#{operator,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'DECISION',#{decision},#{eventType},#{payload}::jsonb) on conflict (tenant_id,terminal_event_key,subscription_id) do nothing

insert into batch.console_push_job_delivery (tenant_id,terminal_event_key,job_instance_id,operator_id,record_type,subscription_id, subscription_fingerprint,event_type,payload_json,delivery_status,next_retry_at) values (#{tenantId},#{eventKey},#{jobId},#{operator},'DEVICE',#{subscriptionId}, #{fingerprint},#{eventType},#{payload}::jsonb,'PENDING',current_timestamp) on conflict (tenant_id,terminal_event_key,subscription_id) do nothing
